questions.text: Which companies are legally permitted to grant Prokura under Austrian business law (sections 48-53 UGB)?
options: All sole proprietorships regardless of their size
Only companies entered in the Commercial Register
Exclusively publicly listed stock corporations
Any entrepreneur and any commercial agent
questions.correctAnswer: Only companies entered in the Commercial Register

questions.text: How must Prokura be legally granted?
options: By express declaration, either in writing or orally
By implied conduct through repeated invoice approval
By automatic promotion after five years of service
Exclusively through a notarized contract in court
questions.correctAnswer: By express declaration, either in writing or orally

questions.text: Which transaction is a holder of Prokura NOT allowed to carry out under statutory Prokura?
options: Hiring or dismissing company employees
Taking out a bank loan for business operations
Representing the company in a dispute in court
Selling or encumbering company real estate
questions.correctAnswer: Selling or encumbering company real estate

questions.text: Management internally bans Prokurist Nesrin Kaya from purchases above EUR 9,500.00. She still buys a delivery van for EUR 65,000.00. What is the legal consequence?
options: The purchase contract with the car dealer is void and must be reversed
The purchase contract applies only if the dealer checks the register first
The contract is valid externally; internally she faces damages and dismissal
Her Prokura terminates automatically before the contract is signed
questions.correctAnswer: The contract is valid externally; internally she faces damages and dismissal

questions.text: Which type of Prokura requires the holder to act only jointly with a managing director or board member?
options: Sole Prokura
Joint Prokura
Branch Prokura
Mixed Prokura

questions.text: How does Prokurist Gunter Eibensteiner correctly sign for ATZ Sonnenschutztechnik e. U.?
options: ATZ Sonnenschutztechnik e. U. / i. A. Gunter Eibensteiner
ATZ Sonnenschutztechnik e. U. / ppa. Gunter Eibensteiner
ATZ Sonnenschutztechnik e. U. / i. V. Gunter Eibensteiner
ATZ Sonnenschutztechnik e. U. / p. A. Gunter Eibensteiner
questions.correctAnswer: ATZ Sonnenschutztechnik e. U. / ppa. Gunter Eibensteiner

questions.text: Sabine Mitterlehner holds Sole Prokura at Kaboom Elektrotechnik GmbH. Which of the following actions is she legally allowed to perform?
options: Signing the company's annual balance sheet
Changing the company name on her own
Granting a special power of attorney to Karin Kofler
Transferring her own Prokura to a deputy
questions.correctAnswer: Granting a special power of attorney to Karin Kofler

questions.text: Every grant and revocation of Prokura must be entered in the Commercial Register and published via the EVI platform.
A holder of Prokura may appoint additional Prokurists whenever needed, provided management does not object.
Name the four types of Prokura and briefly explain why companies often use Joint Prokura.
questions.correctAnswer: The four types are Sole Prokura, Joint Prokura, Mixed Prokura, and Branch Prokura. Companies use Joint Prokura because the holder may act only together with one or more other Prokurists, enforcing the four-eyes principle for shared responsibility and mutual control.
